task_instance: Write UX copy (following the skill's required output template: Recommended Copy, Alternatives table, Rationale, Localization Notes) for the empty-state screen of a 'Projects' dashboard shown to a new user on a team collaboration SaaS app, given a stated context, user state, tone, and character-limit constraints.
evidence: This skill is a pure prompt/reasoning template for an LLM to write copy directly -- it has no bundled scripts, external services, or required tools/APIs (the 'If Connectors Available' section only lists optional enhancements: a knowledge base or design tool, neither required for the core deliverable). Created a sample input request at request.md describing context/user state/tone/constraints (empty state for a Projects dashboard, heading <40 chars, body <120 chars). Produced the full deliverable at output.md following the skill's exact required output structure: Recommended Copy, an Alternatives table with 3 options (tone + best-for columns), a Rationale section explaining word choices against the skill's CTA/empty-state copy patterns, and Localization Notes. Verified the deliverable meets the stated character constraints programmatically with a python3 script: all 3 headings (15, 31, 28 chars) are under the 40-char limit, and all 3 body lines (63, 65, 65 chars) are under the 120-char limit -- all printed 'OK'. No network access, installs, or external tools were needed at any point.
